QA Execution Report — 2026-10-20

ScopeManual execution — Authentication (AUTH) and Admin / User Management (ADM) modules, UI and API test cases, from Project-Documents/test_cases.csv
Coverage100 of 100 in-scope test cases (AUTH UI 22, AUTH API 6, ADM UI 36, ADM API 36)
DescriptionAll 100 in-scope AUTH and ADM cases (UI and API) were executed live on the demo and cross-referenced with exploration.md. 93 passed and 7 failed, giving 7 defects. A disabled account reveals its state at login (BUG-01). The empty Add User form shows a misleading Confirm Password message (BUG-02). The row Edit/Delete buttons have no accessible name (BUG-03). API error bodies use inconsistent error.status types (BUG-04). Create returns 200 instead of 201 (BUG-05). Usernames are stored untrimmed, so the trimmed name cannot sign in (BUG-06). Password reset for an existing user fails with HTTP 504 after 60 s (BUG-07). Every case lists each HTTP call it made in a Hops block or a single Request & Response viewer.
System under testOrangeHRM OS 5.9
EnvironmentShared public demo · https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/
MethodLive execution with Playwright 1.49 (Chromium 1280×720 and API request contexts) driven from Node; every HTTP call recorded as a hop
EvidenceProject-Documents/exploration.md + live observation (255 HTTP calls captured; 68 cases with multi-call Hops)

Ended2026-10-20 08:16:57 UTC

3. Defect Reports

Defects7Defects
One bug report per failed test case. The same reports, with identical IDs and content, are also saved separately in Defect_Reports_2026-10-20.md (same folder).
Defect — BUG-01 · severity Medium–High
[/web/index.php/auth/validate][Disabled account returns "Account disabled" instead of the generic "Invalid credentials", disclosing account state and password correctness]
Traceability: TC-AUTH-UI-007 (contrast case TC-AUTH-UI-008) · FR-AUTH-3, NFR-SEC · exploration D-02 · also reported as BUG-01 in the 2026-10-14 runs
Description
The login endpoint gives two different rejection messages. A disabled account submitted with its correct password is refused with "Account disabled". The same kind of account submitted with a wrong password is refused with "Invalid credentials". Anyone can therefore confirm that a username exists, that it is disabled, and that a guessed password is correct.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign in as Admin and create a test user with POST /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users and the body {"username":"<unique>","password":"qaProbe1","status":false,"userRoleId":2,"empNumber":3}, so the account is disabled.
  2. In a new private browser window, open /web/index.php/auth/login.
  3. Enter the new username and its correct password "qaProbe1", then click Login.
  4. Note the error banner.
  5. Repeat with the same username and a wrong password, for example "totallyWrong1".
  6. Delete the test user afterwards (DELETE /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users with {"ids":[<id>]}).
Expected Result
Both attempts are refused with the same generic banner "Invalid credentials". Nothing reveals whether the account exists, is disabled, or whether the password was correct.
Actual result
Reproduced on 2026-10-20 at 07:40 UTC with the disabled account qadismvgdjafhtas. The correct password produced the banner "Account disabled" (POST /auth/validate → 302 → /auth/login). The wrong password produced "Invalid credentials" (TC-AUTH-UI-008). The disabled user still cannot sign in, but the message reveals the account's state. See TC-AUTH-UI-007.
Defect — BUG-02 · severity Low–Medium
[/web/index.php/admin/saveSystemUser][Empty Add User form shows "Passwords do not match" under Confirm Password instead of "Required"]
Traceability: TC-ADM-UI-013 · FR-ADM-1, NFR-UX · exploration D-03
Description
Clicking Save on an empty Add User form marks User Role, Employee Name, Status, Username and Password as "Required". Confirm Password instead says "Passwords do not match", although nothing has been typed into either password field. The message is misleading and inconsistent with the other five fields.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign in as Admin.
  2. Open Admin > User Management > Users and click Add (/web/index.php/admin/saveSystemUser).
  3. Leave every field empty and click Save.
  4. Read the message under each field.
Expected Result
Confirm Password shows "Required", like its five sibling fields.
Actual result
Reproduced on 2026-10-20 at 07:43 UTC: Confirm Password showed "Passwords do not match", while User Role, Employee Name, Status, Username and Password showed "Required". No request was sent. See TC-ADM-UI-013.
Defect — BUG-03 · severity Medium
[/web/index.php/admin/viewSystemUsers][Row Edit and Delete icon buttons have no accessible name]
Traceability: TC-ADM-UI-033 · NFR-UX (accessibility) · exploration §2.1 automation hazard
Description
Each row of the System Users list has two icon-only buttons, Delete (trash) and Edit (pencil). Neither button has an aria-label, a title or any text, so screen readers announce them only as "button". Assistive technology cannot tell the actions apart, and test automation cannot select them by name.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign in as Admin and open /web/index.php/admin/viewSystemUsers.
  2. Inspect the two buttons inside .oxd-table-cell-actions of any row.
  3. Check each button's accessible name (aria-label, title or text content), for example in the browser's accessibility panel.
Expected Result
Each action button exposes a distinct accessible name, for example "Delete user" and "Edit user".
Actual result
Reproduced on 2026-10-20 at 07:56 UTC: both buttons have an empty accessible name (no aria-label, no title, no text); only the icon (i.bi-trash / i.bi-pencil-fill) tells them apart visually. See TC-ADM-UI-033.
Defect — BUG-04 · severity Low
[/web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users][error.status is a string in 404/422 error bodies but an integer in 401 error bodies]
Traceability: TC-ADM-API-014 · FR-API-6 · exploration D-05
Description
The API's error envelope is not consistently typed. Not-found and validation errors return error.status as a JSON string, while the unauthenticated error returns it as a JSON number. A client that validates or compares error.status with one type will mishandle the other errors.
Steps to reproduce
  1. As Admin, call GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users/999999 and note the type of error.status.
  2. As Admin, call GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users?limit=50&offset=0&sortField=bogusField&sortOrder=ASC and note the type of error.status.
  3. Without a session cookie, call GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users?limit=2&offset=0 and note the type of error.status.
Expected Result
error.status has the same JSON type (for example an integer) in every error response.
Actual result
Reproduced on 2026-10-20 at 07:57 UTC: 404 → {"error":{"status":"404","message":"Record Not Found"}} (string); 422 → "status":"422" (string); 401 → {"error":{"status":401,"message":"Session expired"}} (integer). See TC-ADM-API-014.
Defect — BUG-05 · severity Low
[/web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users][Creating a user returns HTTP 200 instead of 201 Created]
Traceability: TC-ADM-API-016 · FR-API-10 · exploration D-04
Description
POST /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users creates a new system user and returns the new record, but the response status is 200 OK rather than 201 Created. Clients that rely on standard HTTP semantics cannot tell a creation from any other successful call. OrangeHRM's own Professional API documents 201 for the equivalent call.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign in as Admin.
  2. Call POST /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users with Content-Type application/json and the body {"username":"<unique>","password":"qaProbe1","status":true,"userRoleId":2,"empNumber":3}.
  3. Note the HTTP status code and the returned id.
  4. Delete the created user afterwards.
Expected Result
HTTP 201 Created with the persisted record.
Actual result
Reproduced on 2026-10-20 at 07:57 UTC: HTTP 200 with the new record (id 199). The user was created and then deleted by the test. See TC-ADM-API-016.
Defect — BUG-06 · severity Medium
[/web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users][Leading and trailing spaces in a new username are stored, so the user cannot sign in with the trimmed name]
Traceability: TC-ADM-API-043 · FR-ADM-2, FR-AUTH-2 · reported as BUG-06 in the 2026-10-13 automated run
Description
When a user is created with spaces around the username, the API stores the value as typed, spaces included, instead of trimming it. The account then cannot sign in with the visible (trimmed) username. It also allows usernames that look identical but differ only by whitespace.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign in as Admin.
  2. Call POST /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users with {"username":" <unique> ","password":"qaProbe1","status":true,"userRoleId":2,"empNumber":3} (note the spaces).
  3. Note data.userName in the response.
  4. In a new private window, sign in at /web/index.php/auth/login with "<unique>" (no spaces) and "qaProbe1".
  5. Delete the created user afterwards.
Expected Result
The API trims the username on creation (data.userName = "<unique>"), and signing in with the trimmed name succeeds.
Actual result
Reproduced on 2026-10-20 at 07:57 UTC: the response stored userName " qaspcmvge3zbs9yd " with the spaces. Signing in with "qaspcmvge3zbs9yd" was refused with "Invalid credentials". See TC-ADM-API-043.
Defect — BUG-07 · severity High
[/web/index.php/auth/requestResetPassword][Password reset for an existing username fails with HTTP 504 Gateway Time-out after about 60 seconds]
Traceability: TC-AUTH-UI-020 · FR-AUTH-5 · also reported as BUG-02 in the 2026-10-14 manual run and BUG-04 in the 2026-10-13 automated run
Description
Submitting the Reset Password form for an existing username leaves the request pending for about 60 seconds, then nginx returns 504 Gateway Time-out. The user never reaches the confirmation screen, so no real user can complete a password reset.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Make sure a username exists, for example create an enabled test user through Admin > User Management > Users > Add.
  2. Sign out and open /web/index.php/auth/requestPasswordResetCode.
  3. Enter the existing username and click Reset Password.
  4. Wait for the response and note the status code, the time taken and the page shown.
  5. Delete the test user afterwards.
Expected Result
The POST returns 302 to /web/index.php/auth/sendPasswordReset within normal response time, and the "Reset Password link sent successfully" screen is shown.
Actual result
Reproduced on 2026-10-20 at 08:04 UTC with user qaresetmvgedqyt7do: POST /auth/requestResetPassword returned HTTP 504 after 60.2 s, and the browser showed the nginx/1.18.0 "504 Gateway Time-out" page. No confirmation screen was shown. See TC-AUTH-UI-020.

4. Observations (not defects)

Behaviour recorded for the record
Observation — TC-AUTH-UI-013
Usernames are case-insensitive: "admin" signs in to the "Admin" account. The test case only requires deterministic behaviour, so it passed; this is the documented casing rule.
Observation — TC-AUTH-UI-015
Usernames are not trimmed at login: " Admin " is refused with "Invalid credentials". This matches the API storing untrimmed usernames (BUG-06).
Observation — TC-AUTH-UI-004
After a deep-link redirect, login returns the user to the originally requested /admin/viewSystemUsers rather than the dashboard (exploration D-01). The test case expects this; a PRD amendment to FR-AUTH-2 is still recommended.
Observation — TC-ADM-UI-009
For zero results the counter reads "No Records Found" rather than "(0) Records Found", and an info toast "No Records Found" appears. Both mean zero and no rows are rendered, so the case passed; the test case wording could be updated.
Observation — TC-ADM-UI-034
At 1280 px all Admin topbar tabs render inline (User Management · Job · Organization · Qualifications · Nationalities · Corporate Branding · Configuration). "More" appears only at narrower widths. The documented submenus are all reachable, so the case passed.
Observation — TC-ADM-API-011
limit=-1 is rejected with 422 naming "limit", but limit=0 returns every record (no page size applied). Both outcomes are allowed by the test case; returning everything for limit=0 is worth a product review on large datasets.
Observation — TC-ADM-API-029
Deleting a non-existent id returns 404 with message "Records Not Found" (plural), while the single-record GET returns "Record Not Found" (singular). Minor wording inconsistency, recorded for review.
Observation — TC-ADM-UI-036
Deleting an employee in PIM also removes the linked System User (GET /admin/users/{id} → 404; no longer listed). No orphaned account remains.
Environment — shared demo performance
During this run the demo answered slowly: the main JavaScript bundle took about 55 s and pages took 8–18 s. A first full run was aborted for this reason and its results discarded (see the time breakdown). The final run used a runner-side cache for static assets only; every document and API call went to the live server.
Triage — re-executed cases
Three first-attempt failures were test defects, fixed and re-verified: TC-ADM-UI-025/026 (Change Password toggle locator) and TC-ADM-API-005 (sort comparator now matches MySQL case-insensitive collation). TC-AUTH-UI-020 first ended in an error because click() waited for the hanging POST. TC-ADM-UI-032 was first BLOCKED with 20 users and passed after seeding disposable users. No product defect was healed.

5. Test Data & Cleanup

  • Every user this run needed was created by the run itself through POST /api/v2/admin/users (prefixes qadis, qareset, qaemp, qaedit, qadel, qakeep, qaself, qaorph, qapage, qaapi, qaspc, qaauto) and deleted after its case (DELETE 200).
  • Final sweeps confirmed nothing was left behind: main run 29 users, triage re-run 22 users, TC-AUTH-UI-020 re-run 1 user — all returned 404 afterwards.
  • TC-ADM-UI-036 created its own PIM employee (QaOrphan Exec0400, empNumber 396) and deleted it through the PIM UI as the test step; the linked user was removed with it.
  • TC-ADM-UI-035 used a disposable Admin account, never the shared Admin. The anonymous PUT/DELETE probes in TC-ADM-API-034 were refused with 401 and targeted id 1 / non-existent id 999999.
  • No pre-existing record was changed. Password-reset requests were sent only for a disposable user.
